name: Vyapar Books PRO
releaseNotes: Per-remote local databases isolate each CouchDB cloud link
Demo sandbox now runs in a dedicated local database and never syncs to production
Cloud sync link survives app updates, storage resets, and backup/restore
Choose between WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business when sharing on Android
Offline, reconnect, and return-to-live-data controls for safer switching
Sync diagnostics and replication hardening for reliable multi-device use
